about: Two terminals: domestic and international. The terminal complex covers 16,448 sq. m. The 3,000 m runway opened in 2017.

transport.title: Getting there
transport.text: The stop is on the station forecourt. Trolleybus No. 7 goes to the bus station and Krasnodar-1 railway station along Stavropolskaya St. Minibus No. 30 goes to Kooperativny Rynok. The official taxi desk is in Terminal 1, baggage claim area.

terminals.title: Terminals
terminals.text: Terminal 1 serves domestic flights, Terminal 2 international. Check-in counters 1–19; check-in closes 40 minutes before departure.

lounges.title: Lounges
lounges.text: Domestic business lounge: Terminal 1, Level 2, after security checks. International business lounge: Terminal 2, Level 1, after security checks. Admits members of ONPASS, Grey Wall Pass, GoldenKey, RusPriority and other programmes, others for a fee. Stay up to 3 hours.

storage.title: Left luggage
storage.text: On the station forecourt, open round the clock. 400 ₽ per item for the first 24 hours, 200 ₽ for each further 24 hours. One item may weigh up to 30 kg.

kids.title: With children
kids.text: Mother and child room: Terminal 1, Level 1, domestic check-in hall. For passengers with children under 7, children with disabilities under 14 and women in the second half of pregnancy. No charge. Passport and boarding pass or ticket required.

parking.title: Parking
parking.text: Station forecourt: first 15 minutes free, then 400 ₽ per hour. Additional hourly car park to the right of the forecourt: 250 ₽ per hour. Daily car park 900 ₽ per day. The alternative car park is free.

wifi.title: Wi‑Fi
wifi.text: Free Airport_Free network throughout the terminal complex, in the VIP terminal and the business lounge. Login only with a SIM card from a Russian operator.
